# The provisional vessel chrome renders its tab header at the stock height

## Context

Operator's screen recording, 2026-09-26 11:56, at 00:03 and 00:12: the tear-out vessel during the drag shows a tall plain "Metrics" / "Commits" tab header, while the committed popup (00:10, 00:17) shows the compact dock tab header. Measured headless (`ScratchVesselChromeNL`, untracked): during the birth dwell the vessel's `.neo-tab-header-toolbar` is **49 px** with a **48 px** button; after the terminal the committed popup's toolbar is **33 px** with a **32 px** button. The chains differ in exactly the classes the dock projection adds:

- pre-terminal: `div.neo-tab-container-plain.workstation-vessel-provisional-chrome.neo-tab-container.neo-top` under `.workstation-viewport.workstation-popout-host`
- committed: `div.neo-tab-container-plain.neo-dashboard-dock-tabs.neo-tab-container.neo-tab-container-inline.neo-top` under `.neo-dashboard-dock-edge-zone.neo-dashboard` under `.workstation-vessel-dock-host`

## The Problem

`apps/workstation/view/VesselWorkspace.mjs` `resolveVesselStageTarget` (~:836) creates the provisional chrome as a bare `DockTabContainer` with `cls: ['workstation-vessel-provisional-chrome']` and no `ui`. The dock projection (`src/dashboard/dock/projection/LayoutAdapter.mjs` ~:1262-1268) projects every dock tab strip with `cls: ['neo-dashboard-dock-tabs']` and `ui: 'inline'` — "the compact, flush variant" (`src/dashboard/dock/interaction/TabContainer.mjs:46`) — whose `.neo-tab-container-inline > .neo-tab-header-toolbar` rules (`resources/scss/src/tab/Container.scss:16,80`) give the 32 px header. Without the variant the stock theme's `min-width: var(--cmp-button-height)` (48 px) floor wins. The pre-terminal vessel is meant to look like the window it becomes (`#19210`); it looks like a different component for the whole drag.

## Design authority

`#19210`: "A born vessel shows its staged pane in dock chrome from the first frame" — the chrome is defined as the committed projection's; the operator's recording shows the two still differ. No record sentence changes.

## The Fix

`resolveVesselStageTarget`: create the provisional chrome with `ui: 'inline'` and `cls: ['neo-dashboard-dock-tabs', 'workstation-vessel-provisional-chrome']` (the projection's own pair, so the popup's `Viewport.scss` rules — `--tab-header-inline-background-image`, the toolbar ground — apply as they do after the terminal). If the compact height also depends on the `.neo-dashboard-dock-edge-zone` / `.workstation-vessel-dock-host` ancestors rather than the container's classes alone, the stage target wraps the chrome in the same host classes; the measurement decides.

## Acceptance Criteria

- AC-1 (unit, red-first): `Workspace.spec.mjs` › "a vessel's stage target is a provisional tab chrome…" also asserts `ui === 'inline'` and the `neo-dashboard-dock-tabs` class on the created chrome.
- AC-2 (headless, receipt in the PR): the pre-terminal vessel's toolbar and button heights equal the committed popup's (33 / 32 px) on the same tree.
- AC-3 (CI): `unit/apps/workstation` green.

## Out of Scope

- #19248 (the target-side proxy is the tab header) — the other window.
- #19186 (the park's z-order under a real drag).
